afterGlass.title: A window that supports and shows
afterGlass.requirement: Lifecycle achievement: at survey-window, the actual initial survey-camera’s own lens has recorded beacon from that viewpoint through the same local rigid, clear, watertight surface that has the displayed closed north/south profile and actively encloses that initial instrument’s own lens and record plate. A rigid frame elsewhere plus a flexible film does not make one rigid clear surface. This achievement remains earned when that same camera later moves.

conditions.label: actual initial camera made the beacon observation through this rigid clear supporting boundary

afterGlass.title: Soft light, real growth
afterGlass.requirement: Current service: a rootbed at shade-bed is growing, with one actual diffuse watertight boundary actively enclosing the same illuminated tray and seed that are growing. Diffuse light grows this bed but is not a faithful camera view. A diffuser merely attached outside an unchanged enclosure does not satisfy the boundary requirement.

conditions.label: growing bed has a real diffuse enclosing surface

afterGlass.title: Turn daylight toward the bed
afterGlass.requirement: Current service: an exposed reflecting surface at mirror-perch actively supplies an actual light interface to shade-bed in the day row, and that bed grows. A powered lamp remains useful but cannot make an unlit decorative reflector count as the reflecting source. Flexible foil and a rigid reflecting surface are both eligible.

conditions.label: a genuinely lit reflecting surface supplies the perch-to-bed interface

afterGlass.title: Carry the observed instrument into the wet
afterGlass.requirement: Current service: the actual initial survey-camera reaches wet-station retaining its real beacon observation from survey-window. A local flexible watertight boundary now actively encloses that initial instrument’s own lens and record plate. A reusable clear-film shell is a valid answer; no transformation is required merely to rename an adequate wrap.

conditions.label: same observed camera is flexibly enclosed at the wet station
